description: This is a React component file defining the main application component 'App' for a notes application. It manages state for notes, search text, and dark mode, and includes logic for adding, deleting, and persisting notes using localStorage. It also imports several child components.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a new note with provided text, generating a unique ID and current date, then updates the notes state.

methods.name: delNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID from the notes state.
